task.description:
Design the following four frontend-only SHOULD requirements for the Process Designer canvas. Use docs/BPM_Platform_Frontend_Requirements.md for acceptance criteria.

1. **PD-UI-16 — CEL expression editor**: Edge condition inputs on EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY SHALL use a code editor field (Monaco or CodeMirror) with CEL syntax highlighting and basic bracket matching. Server-side syntax errors surfaced inline.

2. **PD-UI-17 — Canvas minimap & zoom**: The canvas SHALL include a minimap for large graphs and zoom controls (fit-to-screen, zoom in/out). React Flow has built-in <MiniMap/> and Controls components.

3. **PD-UI-18 — Auto-layout**: A 'Re-layout' button SHALL apply an automatic DAG layout algorithm (e.g. dagre) to arrange nodes cleanly.

4. **PD-UI-19 — Undo/redo**: The canvas SHALL support undo/redo (Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y) for all canvas operations (add node, delete edge, move node, edit property).
acceptance_criteria: All four requirements have design artefacts (Type B or E per lego-catalog)
Design covers component hierarchy, props, state management, and integration points
No implementation code in the design

result.summary: Design for canvas Batch 2 enhancements — PD-UI-16 (CEL editor), PD-UI-17 (minimap/zoom), PD-UI-18 (auto-layout), PD-UI-19 (undo/redo). All classified Type E. Single prose artefact at src/design/canvas-enhancements.md.
